journal_lines: The web was thick as rope. The eggs were not all hatched. Destroyed what was there. Took time.
Nest in the dark corner of the cave. Cleared it. String everywhere.
Spider colony under a fallen log. Dealt with it. Still picking silk out of the fur.
The eggs hatched while I was working on the adults. Continued working.
String for days. The nest was large.
The cave spider variant. Compact and venomous. Required attention.
Nest abandoned mid-incubation. Finished what was started.
The forest version, not the cave version. String regardless.
Cleared it completely. Nothing left to come back from.
Silk hung wall-to-wall. The nest was inside.
Something was already in the web before I arrived. Cleared the whole system.
The nursery section was behind the adults. Dealt with both.
